REQUIREMENTS.title: Override Base Configuration Safely
REQUIREMENTS.description: The variant app must override only app-specific configuration values while inheriting all base runtime behaviors by default.

breakdown.description: Input requirement: The app shall provide variant overrides in config/app.json and test/config/app.json.
Structure requirement: App overrides shall remain additive or selective, avoiding duplication of unchanged base settings.
Output requirement: Effective app identity and output paths shall resolve correctly from app-level COMMON overrides.

solution.role: Defines app identity overrides (APP_NAME, VERSION, OUTPUT_PREFIX).
Defines app test override scaffold aligned with base test framework.

REQUIREMENTS.title: Provide App-Specific Runtime Extension Points
REQUIREMENTS.description: The variant app must provide extension points for app-specific runtime behavior without modifying base runtime internals.

breakdown.description: Structure requirement: app/app.py shall remain the variant executable entrypoint and call base runtime execution.
Process requirement: utils/apputils.py shall be the designated place for app-specific utility extensions and overrides.
Safety requirement: App customizations should prefer inheritance/override patterns and avoid direct edits to base artifacts.

solution.role: apputils module imports and extends base/data utilities for app-specific logic.

REQUIREMENTS.title: Define App-Specific Functional Behavior
REQUIREMENTS.description: The variant app must define at least one concrete app-specific input-process-output capability beyond base template behavior.

Output requirement: App shall produce at least one app-owned artifact or report derived from app-specific logic.
Verification requirement: App shall include app-owned tests in test/tests/app to validate app-specific behavior.

REQUIREMENTS.title: Maintain App Versioning and Change Documentation
REQUIREMENTS.description: The variant app must maintain app-specific versioning and change history that remains synchronized with app configuration metadata.

breakdown.description: Structure requirement: docs/version/app.txt and config/app.json COMMON.VERSION shall be aligned after app changes.
Output requirement: docs/readme/app.md shall document app-specific behavior and changes.
Process requirement: App updates should be tracked in app-owned update entries.
